notes: A TC 1.5 sight glass, 6 in long when placed (Fritz, 2026-11-05, Rule 5.32). Openings at the left and the right; each IP is the center of its ferrule's outer face. Flow goes either way. Its Length (inches) stretches only the glass: the picture is drawn for its length, so the ferrules keep their shape. Dropped on a straight pipe it cuts the pipe, as a tee does.
